app.title: HarvestIQ
app.tagline: AI-Powered Agriculture Demand, Inventory & Procurement Optimiser

landing.heroTitleLine2: Optimise Seed, Fertilizer & Crop Supply Chains.
landing.heroDescription: HarvestIQ bridges farmer acreage commitments, field observations, and seasonal crop cycles with AI-driven inventory replenishment for Farmer Producer Organisations (FPO).
landing.demandForecastingDesc: Predict seed & fertilizer needs based on active acreage & growth stages.
landing.smartReplenishmentDesc: Dynamic safety stock formulas eliminating stockouts & cash flow pressure.
landing.geminiCopilotDesc: Natural language operational assistant powered by Google Gemini API.
landing.humanControlDesc: AI decision support with mandatory human review & audit logging.
landing.coopRolesTitle: Built for Every Role in Agricultural Cooperatives
landing.coopRolesDesc: HarvestIQ breaks down operational silos across procurement managers, warehouse staff, agronomists, and member farmers.
landing.procurementManagersDesc: Automate Purchase Orders, track supplier lead-time accuracy, and evaluate vendor performance scorecards with empirical delivery metrics.
landing.inventoryPlannersDesc: Monitor batch/lot expiry risks, manage multi-location warehouse bins, and calculate available-to-promise balances dynamically.
landing.agronomistsDesc: Link field observations, crop growth stages, pest risks, and expected yield forecasts directly to input demand requirements.
landing.aiProposesDesc: Unlike black-box automation systems, HarvestIQ uses Google Gemini API to calculate optimal reorder quantities, supplier allocations, and location transfers while keeping authorized managers in full operational control.
landing.conciseExplanationsDesc: Every recommendation presents observable factors, confidence scores, and cash-flow impacts.
landing.mandatoryOverrideDesc: Material overrides require documented business rationale recorded to MongoDB.
landing.auditTrailDesc: Every approval, rejection, and modification is permanently stored for executive review.
landing.sampleRecHeader: Reorder 200 Bags of Hybrid Seed Maize H614
landing.sampleRecBody: Available stock (75 bags) is below reorder threshold (120 bags). Member farm field commitments require 215 bags over next 30 days.
landing.transformingCoopsDesc: Empowering agricultural cooperatives to maintain high service levels without over-leveraging working capital.
landing.slaStatDesc: Eliminate seed & fertilizer stockouts during critical planting windows.
landing.holdingCostStatDesc: Prevent excess inventory accumulation through dynamic safety stock formulas.
landing.expiryStatDesc: First-expiry-first-out (FEFO) tracking for chemical & seed lot shelf life.
landing.overridesStatDesc: Complete audit accountability across all procurement approvals & changes.
landing.footerRights: © 2026 HarvestIQ Platform. All rights reserved. Decision Support Architecture for Agriculture FPOs.
